fields.population.eligibility: Models with an L1 association and comparable non-null Stack/non-Stack scores in at least one step

value: Compare maximum non-Stack and Stack test_score within the same name/version/step; strong less-than, soft equality
population.conditions.quote: A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score.

fields.population.time: All models in database; no requested date restriction

measure.formula.description: Count distinct (name,version,L1_model,status) after per-step classification. Each model contributes at most once to each L1/status; argmax by status.

fields.measure.countGrain: Distinct model name/version per L1_model per status, not steps
